marker_location_hint: bottom third of the cover page, printed next to the Hebrew word 'בהצלחה!' (Good luck!)

variant_symbol_a1.description: Four rounded heart/petal shapes arranged in an X (clover/butterfly-like), with four small pointed leaves between the petals; hollow outline print.

variant_symbol_a2.description: Five pointed petals around a small central circle (star-flower), with two leaves at the sides below; hollow outline print.

variant_symbol_a3.description: A round daisy/chamomile with many (10+) small elongated petals around a large plain circular center; hollow outline print.

mapping_source.derived: 2026-07-13, manual inspection of authoritative printed material (not student answers); CONFIRMED by the exam owner on 2026-07-13 (four-petal flower=A1, five-petal flower=A2, daisy=A3)
evidence: Answer key page 3 legend: 'הצבעים הם R,B,G לפי A1, A2, A3 בהתאם' — the key encodes the three variants as A1/A2/A3.

Answer key page 11, item 16 note: version 2's printed wording of the Hough-triangles question says the triangles are parallel to the x-axis (answer: minimal dimension 3); versions 1 and 3 say any orientation (answer: 4).
Exam test/003 (five_petal_star cover) prints the Hough-triangles question as #20 with the 'one side parallel to the X axis' wording -> version 2 -> A2.

Exam test/002 (many_petal_daisy cover) prints the Hough-triangles question as #18 with the 'any orientation' wording -> version 1 or 3; it is not A1 because its question order differs from the key's canonical order -> A3.

sample_data/student_exam.pdf (four_petal_clover cover) is the instructor-verified A1 exam (docs/evaluation.md ground truth); its printed question order matches the key's canonical order exactly (page 10 prints #18 Canny, #19 Harris, #20 Rectification = key items 18/19/20), and the key's own cover carries the same four-petal flower.
Question order and option order SHUFFLE between variants (Hough question printed at #16/#20/#18 in A1/A2/A3 respectively) — scoring requires the per-variant question alignment, see docs/variants.md.
